Multiple Criminals Killed or Injured in Uttar Pradesh Police Encounters

Several police encounters across Uttar Pradesh have resulted in the deaths and injuries of wanted criminals. In Lucknow, a criminal carrying a reward of ₹1 lakh, identified as the main accused in a property dealer's murder, was killed. In Shamli, a criminal with a ₹50,000 reward, wanted in multiple cases, was killed, and a sub-inspector was injured. Other encounters in Pilibhit, Varanasi, and Jaunpur also led to arrests and injuries.
